payload.topic: What are we building, and for whom?

payload.text: Jarvis is a voice assistant. Timers and reminders must fit its router, its session loop and its plugin rules.
Keep timers in a small plugin driven by a heartbeat, so the core never learns about timers.
One timer plugin, one Tick event, one fake clock for tests.
A heartbeat per second drifts. Compare against the clock, never count ticks.
Agreed: the plugin stores deadlines and checks them on each tick.
An alert could talk over the user.
The alert needs the session's speaking state.
Let us settle the alert rule before we split the work.

payload.title: Alerts wait while Jarvis speaks or listens

payload.description: Write the timer plugin against the clock port
Expose the speaking state to the plugin

comments: List the refusals: zero, negative, over 24 hours.

payload.text: Timers live in a plugin driven by Tick events and an injected clock. Alerts wait for speech. Memory only. PRD approved.
